name: What is the typical timeline for under cabinet lighting installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for under cabinet lighting installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for under cabinet lighting installation can vary depending on the scope of the project. For a standard kitchen with existing outlets or easily accessible wiring, the installation typically takes one to two days. If new electrical circuits need to be run, or if custom cabinetry modifications are required, the project could extend to several days. We provide a clear project timeline during the initial consultation, ensuring you know what to expect.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1-2 days for a standard kitchen; projects requiring new wiring or custom modifications may take longer.
